# Known issue with leaving a Random start before trader assignment

**Do not log out until your first trader is assigned. Complete the opening tasks in the same session and wait for the Journey to Settlement trader marker.** You can visit the trader later.

Leaving earlier, including an unexpected session end, may point the quest to a Pine Forest trader when you return. Your landing remains saved and will not repeat. If you already left early, follow the trader marker you receive on return. Standard starts use the game's normal route.

This affects the opening trader route in Random mode. The manager reminder does not repair the early-exit behavior. HRS can also legitimately select a trader in another biome when no usable local route is available; a Pine Forest marker alone does not establish this issue.

If no trader destination is assigned during an uninterrupted opening session, or an already assigned destination is lost after returning, keep the HRS diagnostic and report that behavior for investigation.
